info.desc: Power Windows is the eleventh studio album by the Canadian rock band Rush, released in 1985 . The album was recorded at The Manor in England, Air Studios in Montserrat and at Sarm East in London. Power Windows introduced more keyboard synthesizers into the band's sound, and featured very precise drumming and guitar. Generally, short, echoey guitar "bursts" tend to outnumber solos as well as riffs. The result is a very open and dynamic yet somewhat spartan sound. podcast.body: This album features the song "The Big Money," which addresses themes of corporate greed prevalent in the 1980s. Neil Peart's lyrics for the song were inspired by a 1936 novel from John Dos Passos, part of a trilogy depicting 12 characters navigating the Great Depression, with Peart adapting these sentiments to the global economy of his time.
